paragraphs.text: More people are keeping a few chickens in their gardens for fresh eggs. Chickens are relatively easy to care for, but they need a secure house where they can sleep and lay eggs, safe from foxes.

Each bird needs enough space to move around outside during the day. A small flock of three or four hens is usually enough for a family and will produce several eggs a day in spring and summer, though fewer in winter.
Chickens eat special feed pellets, which contain the nutrients they need, and they also enjoy some kitchen scraps. However, some foods, such as raw potato skins, can make them ill.

Hens should be checked daily for signs of illness, and their house must be cleaned regularly to prevent mites. Neighbours are more likely to accept chickens if no cockerel is kept, as cockerels crow loudly early in the morning.
Most hens stop laying regularly after three or four years but can live for much longer.

items.quote: they need a secure house where they can sleep and lay eggs, safe from foxes

explanation.en: “a secure house … safe from foxes” → foxes, letter D.
explanation.kk: «a secure house … safe from foxes» — түлкіден қорғалған үй → foxes, яғни D әрпі.
explanation.ru: «a secure house … safe from foxes» → foxes, буква D.

items.quote: will produce several eggs a day in spring and summer, though fewer in winter

explanation.en: “several eggs a day in spring and summer, though fewer in winter” → summer, letter H. A (winter) is when there are fewer.
explanation.kk: «several eggs a day in spring and summer, though fewer in winter» → summer, яғни H әрпі. A (winter) — жұмыртқа аз болатын кез.
explanation.ru: «several eggs a day in spring and summer, though fewer in winter» → summer, буква H. A (winter) — время, когда яиц меньше.

explanation.en: “Chickens eat special feed pellets” → pellets, letter F. E (potatoes) is a trap: raw potato skins can make them ill.
explanation.kk: «Chickens eat special feed pellets» → pellets, яғни F әрпі. E (potatoes) — тұзақ: шикі картоп қабығы зиянды.
explanation.ru: «Chickens eat special feed pellets» → pellets, буква F. E (potatoes) — ловушка: сырая картофельная кожура опасна.

items.quote: their house must be cleaned regularly to prevent mites

explanation.en: “cleaned regularly to prevent mites” → mites, letter B. “Avoid” = “prevent”.
explanation.kk: «cleaned regularly to prevent mites» → mites, яғни B әрпі. «Avoid» = «prevent».
explanation.ru: «cleaned regularly to prevent mites» → mites, буква B. «Avoid» = «prevent».

items.quote: Neighbours are more likely to accept chickens if no cockerel is kept

explanation.en: “if no cockerel is kept” → cockerel, letter G. C (neighbours) are the ones who might complain.
explanation.kk: «if no cockerel is kept» → cockerel, яғни G әрпі. C (neighbours) — шағымданатындар, ұстамайтын нәрсе емес.
explanation.ru: «if no cockerel is kept» → cockerel, буква G. C (neighbours) — те, кто жалуется, а не то, чего не держат.
